newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis hurt in petrol bomb attack on bus.
newsitem.headline: Israelis hurt in petrol bomb attack on bus.

text.p: An Israeli bus overturned and burned after being hit by a petrol bomb near a Palestinian refugee camp, wounding up to 15 Israelis, security sources said.
They said three were seriously injured.
ISRAELI MILITARY CENSORS MADE DELETIONS FROM THIS REPORT
Reuters photographer David Silverman heard a soldier being escorted from the bus to a military ambulance tell a doctor that a petrol bomb had hit the bus.
Palestinian security officials confirmed a bus had overturned near the Palestinians' Jalazoun refugee camp, north of Jerusalem, but offered few details.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
Violence has flared for two weeks in the West Bank since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
U.S. President Bill Clinton will meet Netanyahu in Washington on Monday for talks on saving Israeli-Palestinian peace negotiations.
Palestinians complain Jewish settlement construction pre-empts the results of final peace talks yet to come on the status of East Jerusalem, which each side claims as its own.
Netanyahu's media adviser Shai Bazak, said on Wednesday that bulldozers would go on digging for the settlement even if Washington, Israel's closest ally, pressured it to stop.
Earlier on Wednesday, Palestinian stone-throwers clashed north of Jerusalem with soldiers who responded with teargas and rubber bullets.
